title: feat(metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, client)!: the dataset query doors (single and batch) and /meta/dataset take the reader's package (?callerPackage=) and resolve the name by ADR-0150 D3
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9MPgD7mFnX4Q6NRcD45kbe)_

Fixes #32310

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` and `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query/batch`: `?callerPackage=` was accepted and ignored on both (`200`, the bare read's dataset); it now resolves the name from that package (ADR-0150 D3) and answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (ambiguous in, or held only outside, the package's closure; on the batch, that query's entry) or `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (beside `?package=`, blank, `all`, not a string, repeated; on the batch, the whole request). A composed protocol with a by-name read but no caller resolution, or an engine registry that cannot judge package-scoped names, answers `503` where it answered `200`. First-party senders before this change: 0 on either door, repo-wide with `ui/` included. The `/meta/dataset/:name` arm is the widening half: it was refused `400` as an unknown parameter. Every package ships `patch` (no metadata author can write anything new). ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset. Skills-docs: none (`skills/**` teaches neither the query doors nor `?callerPackage=`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据集查询入口(单条与批量)和 `/meta/dataset/:name` 新增 `?callerPackage=`,按"读者所在包"解析数据集名:先本包,再依赖闭包加 `sys` 中唯一持有者,否则 409。批量入口里参数写错整批 400,解析失败只影响那一条。客户端 SDK 三个方法同步加了选项。
- 为什么改:`?package=` 只能精确指定持有包,包内仪表盘读依赖包的数据集无从表达;#32309 合并后这类图表在 main 上会被 409 拒绝,本 PR 是 UI 切到 `callerPackage` 的前提(ADR-0150 D3)。
- 风险与回滚:两个查询入口以前会忽略这个参数,现在会拒绝或改为按包解析;仓内调用方 0 个。`all` 和空值一律 400,不会落回裸读。裸读与 `?package=` 逐字节不变(实测 9/9)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`(`resolveCallerPackageAddress`,解析顺序与未安装包的处理);`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`(规则 4 的拒绝条件与先于规则 3 的顺序、查询改写);`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`(`answerDatasetQuery` 里的接线与批量入口的整批拒绝)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-routes.test.ts -t 32310`,预期 10 例全绿(本包、依赖包、两持有者 409、闭包外 409、未安装包同 `?package=`、参数错误 400、503 兜底、批量逐条解析、批量整批 400、对照组)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `resolveCallerPackageAddress({ type, name, callerPackageId, member? })` on the protocol. It composes core's `resolvePackageScopedHolders` rule with metadata-core's `packageResolutionClosure` over the registry's own reads (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, `getPackageScopedItem`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`), and answers the holder to read: a package id, or the environment. Ambiguity and outside-closure throw `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`). A caller that is not an installed package (no registry entry, no residual owner) is answered as its own id, so the read becomes exactly `?package=<that id>` and never the bare read.
- **`@objectstack/rest`**: `callerPackage` joins the `/meta` item read's closed query set, with a fourth refusal rule (`metaItemCallerPackageRefusalMessage`): `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming both parameters when it is sent with `?package=`, on a type other than `dataset`, blank, `all` (which `?package=` reads as naming no package) or not a string. Rule 4 is asked before rule 3 (a member on the layered view), because both transports let rule 3 through at the entry and answer it later. The qualified path `/meta/dataset/NS/:name` refuses the arm the same way. `metaCallerPackageQuery` resolves through the protocol and rewrites the query to `?package=<holder>` (or drops it for the environment), so admission and every answer after resolution are the qualified read's.
- **The query doors**: `answerDatasetQuery`, the one judgment the single and batch doors share since #32200, refuses a repeated or malformed arm and resolves a `datasetName` through `metaCallerPackageQuery`; a protocol with no resolver answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. A well-formed arm beside an inline `dataset` body is not read, as `?package=` is not; a malformed one is refused, inline body or not. The batch door reads the arm once from its URL: a malformed arm (repeated, blank, `all`, not a string, beside `?package=`) refuses the whole batch `400` before any query runs, as its existing repeat gate does; each query's resolution, its `409` and its `404`, is that query's entry.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**: the dispatcher's `/meta` item read and qualified path carry the same rules through the shared `@objectstack/rest` decision.
- **`@objectstack/client`**: `analytics.queryDataset(payload, { callerPackage })`, `analytics.queryDatasetBatch(queries, { callerPackage })` and `meta.getItem(type, name, { callerPackage })` (both the unscoped and the scoped client) send it.
- **Docs**: one paragraph in `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` beside `?package=`, and a sentence in the batch paragraph.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (real `SchemaRegistry` + protocol): own, dependency, `sys`, two in closure (409 naming both), outside closure, environment-only (409 outside-closure), uninstalled caller equals `?package=`, nothing holds the name, CONTROL.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`: both `/meta` transports, real registry, including the qualified-path 400, `all`, the arm beside `?layers=&member=` (rule 4 before rule 3) and the CONTROL.
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`: the query door and the batch door, 10 cases including `all` and a non-string value, the 503 fail-closed protocol, per-entry `409`/`404` on the batch and its whole-batch `400`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-query-decision.test.ts`: rule 4.
- `packages/client/src/package-addressing.test.ts`: the client options, including `queryDatasetBatch`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/dataset-package-scoped-readers.dogfood.test.ts`: a booted stack with four caller packages, 8 new cases, including `all` on both doors and the batch door.
- Forced test changes (each roster pins the parameter set or a method's source): the `/meta` closed-set lists in `meta-item-query-decision.test.ts` (rest and runtime) and `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts`, the canonical-fold roster in `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`, and the `queryDataset` source pin in `envelope-caller-census.test.ts`. Three touched test files gained a module-top side-effect import so a lazy load is paid at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).

## Acceptance notes

- The holder set is the bare read's (`packageScopedHoldersOf`), so it counts a disabled package the same way the bare read does today; #32183 is not landed.
- The resolution is composed in metadata-protocol from core's rule and metadata-core's closure, because metadata-protocol cannot import objectql's `resolvePackageScopedName` adapter. It is the same three reads.
- The caller is read only from the explicit query parameter, never from a header or the session.
- An unknown caller package answers what `?package=` answers for that id: `409` naming the holders, `404` when nothing holds the name. `all` and a blank value are refused `400`; no value falls back to the bare read.
- Since #32277 the arm reads the exact qualifier's rule for which types are addressed by package (core's `isPackageScopedType`, never a list the registry supplies) and needs the exact qualifier's registry reads; without them it fails closed with `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` on every door (on the batch, per entry), and the dispatcher answers that `503` itself. An uninstalled caller's answer was re-measured on main at `9bff554e`: still exactly `?package=<id>`'s (`409` naming the holders, `404` when nothing holds the name).
- The client sends nothing for an empty `callerPackage` (`if (options?.callerPackage)`), so the read is bare and the server's blank `400` is not reached from the SDK. Left as is on purpose: it mirrors how the same client treats `packageId`.

### out_of_scope_findings

- carrier `seat`: the ui callers of #32309 (merged) switch from `package` to `callerPackage` (`analytics.queryDataset(payload, { callerPackage })`, `analytics.queryDatasetBatch(queries, { callerPackage })` and `meta.getItem('dataset', name, { callerPackage })`), so a package's dashboard reads a dependency's dataset instead of being refused `409`.

## Verification

The runtime pin found the dispatcher leaving the arm's `503` to an outer catch; it now answers it with `errorFromThrown`.

The bare door: `200`, serving the dependency's dataset. `/meta/dataset/d?package=P`: `409`. `?package=<unknown>`: `409` naming the holders on both doors (`404` when nothing holds the name).
- The query door with `?callerPackage=P` was accepted and ignored: `200`, the bare read. `/meta/dataset/:name?callerPackage=` was `400` as an unknown parameter.
